stops.name: Naturpark Flusslandschaft Peenetal
stops.detail: The Nature Park River Landscape Peenetal is a nature park in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. It was established on 19 July [dated source] by a state ordinance. The seat of the nature park is in Stolpe an der Peene. The Peene Valley is considered the largest contiguous low moor area in Central Europe. There were 156 bird and 37 fish species counted, which is why the Peene is named as the probably most biodiverse river of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.
